title: THE HICKSTON INCIDENT
heading: BESSIE'S
COMIN' HOME

stations.label: UNBOLT THE STOCK GATE
stations.message: STOCK GATE OPEN. THE LANE'S RIGHT THERE.

stations.label: LIFT THE YARD BAR
stations.message: YARD BAR UP. STRAIGHT BACK DOWN THE LANE.

notes: MUNDELL / YOUR HOG TAG WENT TO THE FAIR. CHECK THE BLUE TRUNK.

do.message: THE DISPATCH SAFE HAD A BELL ON IT. COMPANY IS COMING.
THE CONGREGATION RISES. THEY'VE BEEN PROBED.
SOMETHING JUST SET DOWN IN THE NORTH PASTURE. BESSIE'S OUT THERE.
SOMETHING'S BEEN SLEEPING IN THE HAY.
